static_traits.name: 张雯
static_traits.family_status: 与配偶及子Female同住，Family relationships紧密、互相支持
static_traits.social_status: 与上司Relationship tension；更倾向于就工作问题寻求专业帮助而非打扰家人
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理咨询或治疗史；以往not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: Tone neutral; able to clearly describe concrete work situations and feelings; highly cooperative, willing to try cognitive-behavioral experiments; able to conduct self-observation and give examples

basic_info.main_problem: 每周工作超过60小时，持续担心过度工作会导致被解雇，该恐惧引发显著压力与Anxiety，影响工作专注与家庭休息。
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping through counseling to relieve the persistent fear of losing the job, improve mental health and overall well-being, so as to be more focused at work and more relaxed at home.

special_situations.event: 上个月餐厅举办大型活动，整体顺利完成
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not做到完美或超出目标，就说明I am not good enough，工作not保
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班投入更多时间准备；在高压时段进行短暂休息与深呼吸来压住Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not算，我还是not做够，可能会被解雇

special_situations.event: 上司在工作场合露出严肃的表情或反馈not够积极
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果上司have not明确表扬或面色严肃，就代表我表现not合格、职位岌岌可危
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更用力工作、延长工时以弥补可能的not足，尽量减少错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他对我not满，我很可能会被辞退

special_situations.event: 上周错过一个小的截止时间
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 任何错误都会带来严重后果（比如被解雇）
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班赶工、持续紧张地Self-monitoring任务进度
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 完了，这次他们要解雇我了

special_situations.event: 工作负荷显著增加，每周工作超过60小时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法在高负荷下仍然完美达成所有目标，那么过度工作也会被视为without能，终将被解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistently works overtime to prove themselves; arranges short breaks and deep breathing at work to maintain state
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我过度工作反而会导致被解雇，事情会很糟糕

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被上司认可、保持工作的安全感与稳定性
core_conflict.fear: 害怕not够好被negate，最终被解雇与失去保障
defense_goal: 通过加班与自我控制来维持表现、降低被解雇的风险
尽量not让家人担心，将问题控制在可承受范围内

object_relations.self_representation: 紧张not安、随时可能被淘汰的员工
object_relations.object_representation: 高要求、严苛且容易negate的上司

manifestations: 在高压工作环境下感到Restricted choices
每周工作超过60小时以满足外部目标
自我价值高度绑定于上司的评价与业绩

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将老板的业绩目标视为必须达成的绝对标准
把“任何错误都会让我丢工作”的信条not yet经检验地内化

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 在面对负面反馈或挑战性任务时过度自我批评，反复担心“not够好”
not想让家人过度担心而倾向于将压力对内处理

exception_events.target_problem: 在错过截止时间时，来访者通常会灾难化预测并认为自己会被解雇，Anxiety intensified、难以专注工作。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上周错过一个小的截止时间后，来访者并not yet被解雇，且通过短暂休息与深呼吸缓解Anxiety并继续完成工作。
exception_events.reason: 线索：采取了短暂休息与深呼吸的not同做法；not同证据：以往也曾错过小截止但not yet被警告或解雇，上司并not yet明确表示职位有风险。

exception_events.target_problem: Under the pressure of large events, the client usually ignores positive outcomes and persistently worries about being fired.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上个月餐厅大型活动整体顺利完成，来访者成功组织并推进准备工作，事实与其灾难化预测not一致。
exception_events.reason: Cue: the smooth outcome of the activity provided contrary evidence; arranging brief rests and deep breathing amid busyness to maintain state helped them complete the key task.

positive_force: 拥有支持性的家庭体系，愿意倾诉
主动寻求专业帮助并愿意参与行为实验
具备基础的压力管理方法（短暂休息、深呼吸）
在高负荷下仍能完成关键任务（大型活动顺利）
negative_force: 灾难化、negate积极、心理过滤、预测not yet来等认知偏差显著
自我价值高度依赖外部评价（上司目标与反馈）
长期高强度加班导致身心负荷过重
与上司Relationship tension，负面反馈易triggerAnxiety
Declining sleep quality与日常功能受损

target_behavior.behavior: 工作相关的高度Anxiety与灾难化预测（持续担心被解雇）
antecedent: 在工作中遇到艰难任务
错过小的截止时间或not yet达目标
工作负荷显著增加（每周>60小时）
target_behavior.core_reason: 在高压与高期望环境下，将外界业绩标准not yet经消化地内化为个人价值，伴随灾难化、心理过滤、negate积极与预测not yet来等认知偏差，导致对被解雇的过度担忧。
target_behavior.function: 通过加班与过度努力来逃避“not够好”的感受并寻求外部认可与安全感；通过短暂休息与深呼吸来缓解即时Anxiety。
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus与绩效受影响；与上司Relationship tension；睡眠质量变差；日常功能受损；持续的压力与Anxiety。
